title: Your data
summary: Export, backup and where the data lives.

requirements.text: Export writes a consistent snapshot of the whole database, photos included, and hands it to the Android share sheet (on desktop, shows the file's path).
Photos are stored in the database, named by the SHA-256 of their bytes.
When the last backup is older than `backup.stale-after`, the app reminds the user to make one.
Copies the app makes of the database (exports, snapshots, the pre-migration backup) are marked as copies.
Schema changes are applied as versioned migrations when the app starts.
